purpose: 判读回流登记簿：每条新 SC 判读的归因与回流处置，判读→阶段二的唯一受控接口。回流标准（四条全过才回流）：① 判读分支非正向（precondition_mismatch / i_too_weak / violation_not_observed；violation_reproduced 只入对照计数）② 差异重放归因确认肇事者是阶段二侧 ③ 缺陷可泛化成模式（不是案例孤例）④ 修复能落进修复阶梯（第0层机械门/advisory 优先，第1层提示词规则，第2层 schema/plan）并能写回归测试。归因由差异重放（--experiment 工作区，零模型）产生机械证据，人最终确认；未经确认的判读不触发任何规则改动。红线：冻结 run 永不被改写；规则改动使旧测量作废，须冻结下一个 holdout。

bisection.binding_substitution: skipped, mechanically excluded: the 4 binding_sanity asserts anchor every observable to the PoC's actual values (fot=990, liab=2000, bal=1980, insolvency), so no binding change can make the scenario-pinned P true
bisection.constraints_substitution: constraints_v2: same report re-formalized scenario-general (P fot>0; I fot>0 -> liab<=bal; V fot>0 & liab>bal), applied consistently to the run copy's constraints.json AND formalization.json (the stage-3 binding contract derives its symbol set from the latter); binding_v2 drops only the now-unreferenced standard_deposit_received symbol (coverage-compat, no observable changed)
bisection.conclusion: CONFIRMED against the pre-registered expectation, item by item: same report, same slice, same PoC observables (binding_sanity 4/4), only the stage-2 representation changed -- the verdict flips precondition_mismatch -> violation_reproduced. Culprit = the stage-2 representation choice (scenario-pinned P), not translation infidelity; the report's example arithmetic is the contributing factor

entries.contributing_factor: the report's example arithmetic (990/1000/1990/2000) invites the pinning; the stage-2 translation itself stayed faithful to the report text
